questions.question_te: Earth interior నుంచి surface process వరకు సరైన cause chain ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which is the correct cause chain from Earth interior to surface processes?
options_te: Interior heat → plate motion → relief → weathering and drainage
options_en: Interior heat → plate motion → relief → weathering and drainage
Rainfall → inner core → orbit
Population → mantle → latitude
Trade → magma → longitude
option_explanations_en: This is a connected Earth-system chain.
Rainfall does not create the inner core.
Population does not create the mantle or latitude.
Trade does not create magma or longitude.
questions.source_paragraph: Earth interiorలోని heat mantle convection, plate motionకు energy sourceగా పనిచేస్తుంది. Plate boundaries mountain building, earthquakes, volcanismను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి. Relief weathering, erosion, drainageపై ప్రభావం చూపుతుంది; climate ఈ surface processes వేగాన్ని మార్చుతుంది.
questions.explanation_te: Interior heat నుంచి plate motion, relief, surface processes వరకు causal linkage ఉంది.
questions.explanation_en: There is a causal linkage from interior heat through plate motion and relief to surface processes.

questions.question_en: Which statement correctly explains atmosphere–ocean coupling?
options_te: Unequal heating pressure gradientsను, winds currentsను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి
options_en: Unequal heating affects pressure gradients, and winds affect currents
Currents have no relation to winds
Coriolis completely removes pressure gradients
Ocean currents do not affect climate
option_explanations_en: The heating–pressure–wind–current chain is correct.
Winds are a major forcing of surface currents.
Coriolis deflects direction; it does not remove the gradient.
Currents influence coastal climate.
questions.source_paragraph: Unequal solar heating pressure gradientsను సృష్టిస్తుంది; pressure-gradient force airను కదిలిస్తుంది. Coriolis effect global wind directionను మళ్లిస్తుంది. Winds ocean currentsను నడిపిస్తాయి; currents coastal temperature, fog, aridity, marine productivityపై ప్రభావం చూపుతాయి.
questions.explanation_te: Unequal heating నుంచి pressure gradient, wind, current వరకు chainను గుర్తించాలి.
questions.explanation_en: Recognise the chain from unequal heating to pressure gradient, wind and current.

questions.question_en: Which statement is correct in river-basin thinking?
options_te: Upstream land use downstream flood and sediment conditionsను మార్చగలదు
options_en: Upstream land use can change downstream flood and sediment conditions
A watershed is always a state border
Infiltration is not part of the water cycle
Runoff exists only in the atmosphere
option_explanations_te: Basin connectivity వల్ల upstream effects downstreamకు వెళ్తాయి.
Natural watershed administrative borderతో తప్పనిసరిగా సరిపోలదు.
option_explanations_en: Basin connectivity carries upstream effects downstream.
A natural watershed need not match an administrative border.
Infiltration is part of the water cycle.
Runoff flows over the land surface.
questions.source_paragraph: Evaporation, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, runoff కలిసి water cycleను నిర్మిస్తాయి. River basinలో upstream land use downstream flood peak, sediment load, water qualityను మార్చగలదు. Watershed boundary administrative borderతో తప్పనిసరిగా సరిపోలదు.
questions.explanation_te: River basin ఒక connected system; upstream change downstream outcomeను ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation_en: A river basin is a connected system; upstream change can affect downstream outcomes.

questions.question_te: Soil formation మరియు vegetation feedbackపై సరైనది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which statement about soil formation and vegetation feedback is correct?
options_te: Climate, organisms, relief, time soilను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి; vegetation soil protectionకు సహాయపడుతుంది
options_en: Climate, organisms, relief and time affect soil; vegetation helps protect soil
Parent material alone determines soil
Vegetation gives no environmental feedback
Relief does not affect drainage
option_explanations_te: ఇది multi-factor formation మరియు feedbackను గుర్తిస్తుంది.
Vegetation evapotranspiration, carbon storage, soil coverపై ప్రభావం చూపుతుంది.
Slope and relief drainageను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి.
option_explanations_en: It recognises multi-factor formation and feedback.
Soil formation has several factors.
Vegetation affects evapotranspiration, carbon storage and soil cover.
Slope and relief affect drainage.
questions.source_paragraph: Parent material soil mineralsకు base ఇస్తుంది; climate weathering మరియు leachingను, organisms humusను, relief drainageను, time profile developmentను ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి. Vegetation climateకు response మాత్రమే కాదు; soil protection, evapotranspiration, carbon storage ద్వారా environmentపై తిరిగి ప్రభావం చూపుతుంది.
questions.explanation_te: Soil ఒక factor వల్ల కాదు; vegetation కూడా passive response మాత్రమే కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Soil is not produced by one factor, and vegetation is not merely a passive response.

questions.question_te: ఒకే cyclone రెండు ప్రాంతాల్లో వేర్వేరు disaster outcomes ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం ఏది?
questions.question_en: Why can the same cyclone produce different disaster outcomes in two regions?
options_en: Differences in exposure, vulnerability and capacity
A cyclone has no wind
Latitude is identical everywhere
A disaster has no relation to a hazard
option_explanations_te: Latitude మారుతుంది; కానీ answer risk factorsపై ఉంది.
option_explanations_en: Risk context varies by place.
A cyclone can have strong winds.
Latitude varies, but the answer concerns risk factors.
Hazard is one component of disaster risk.
questions.source_paragraph: Hazard ఒక damaging process లేదా eventకు అవకాశం. Exposure people and assets ఎక్కడ ఉన్నాయో చెబుతుంది; vulnerability ఎంత సులభంగా నష్టం కలుగుతుందో చెబుతుంది; capacity ఎదుర్కొనే సామర్థ్యం. ఒకే cyclone వేర్వేరు placesలో వేర్వేరు disaster outcomes ఇవ్వవచ్చు.
questions.explanation_te: Hazard intensityతో పాటు ఎవరు exposed, ఎంత vulnerable, ఎంత capacity ఉందో outcomeను నిర్ణయిస్తాయి.
questions.explanation_en: Along with hazard intensity, exposure, vulnerability and capacity shape the outcome.

questions.question_te: High population density గురించి defensible inference ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which is a defensible inference about high population density?
options_te: అది ఒక ratio; poverty లేదా overpopulationను ఒంటరిగా నిరూపించదు
options_en: It is a ratio and alone does not prove poverty or overpopulation
It necessarily means extreme poverty
It is determined only by climate
It equals population count
option_explanations_te: Densityకు area denominator ఉంటుంది; wellbeingకు మరిన్ని indicators అవసరం.
High density prosperous citiesలో కూడా ఉంటుంది.
Distributionకు అనేక physical and human factors ఉన్నాయి.
option_explanations_en: Density has an area denominator; wellbeing needs other indicators.
High density also occurs in prosperous cities.
Distribution has many physical and human drivers.
Count and density are different.
questions.source_paragraph: Population distributionను climate లేదా relief ఒక్కటితో వివరించలేం. Water, soils, jobs, transport, history, policy, conflict, technology కలిసి settlement patternను రూపొందిస్తాయి. Density ఒక ratio; అధిక density అంటే తప్పనిసరిగా poverty లేదా overpopulation అని కాదు.
questions.explanation_te: Density ఒక ratio మాత్రమే; deprivation లేదా carrying capacityపై విడిగా evidence అవసరం.
questions.explanation_en: Density is only a ratio; deprivation or carrying capacity requires separate evidence.

questions.question_te: Resource presence alone industrial developmentకు ఎందుకు సరిపోదు?
questions.question_en: Why is resource presence alone insufficient for industrial development?
options_te: Technology, capital, labour, energy, transport, markets, institutions కూడా అవసరం
Resource ఉన్న చోట demand అవసరం లేదు
options_en: Technology, capital, labour, energy, transport, markets and institutions also matter
Demand is unnecessary where a resource exists
Industry has no relation to transport
Value addition eliminates agriculture
option_explanations_en: Industrial location is a multi-factor decision.
Demand and market conditions matter.
Transport connects inputs and outputs.
Agro-industry is linked to agriculture.
questions.source_paragraph: Natural substance technology, demand, access, institutionsతో ఉపయోగపడినప్పుడు resource అవుతుంది. Agriculture raw material ఇవ్వవచ్చు; industry value addition చేస్తుంది; transport and communication marketsను కలుపుతాయి. Resource presence alone industrial developmentకు సరిపోదు.
questions.explanation_te: Resourceను productionగా మార్చడానికి technological, economic, infrastructural, institutional conditions అవసరం.
questions.explanation_en: Turning a resource into production requires technological, economic, infrastructural and institutional conditions.

questions.question_te: Dynamic statisticను విశ్వసనీయంగా ఉపయోగించడానికి అవసరమైన metadata ఏది?
questions.question_en: What metadata is needed to use a dynamic statistic reliably?
options_en: Year, unit, denominator and source
Colour only
Capital city only
Mountain name only
option_explanations_te: ఇవి valueను interpret, compare చేయడానికి అవసరం.
option_explanations_en: These are needed to interpret and compare the value.
Colour is not statistical metadata.
A capital city is not statistical metadata.
A mountain name is not statistical metadata.
questions.source_paragraph: World map broad pattern చూపుతుంది; regional map local contrast చూపుతుంది. Global averageను ప్రతి localityకి వర్తింపజేయకూడదు. Dynamic statisticకు year, unit, denominator, source అవసరం; physical location factకు map evidence ముఖ్యం.
questions.explanation_te: Year, unit, denominator, source లేకపోతే dynamic value అర్థం లేదా comparability తప్పిపోవచ్చు.
questions.explanation_en: Without year, unit, denominator and source, the meaning or comparability of a dynamic value may be lost.
